description: Config.__init__ removes expect_arch from its parameters but retains its reference in the assertion message.
trigger: With assertions enabled, instantiate a configuration class against a file whose single architecture differs from that class's arch_string.
expected_behavior: Reject the mismatch with an AssertionError identifying the actual and expected architectures.
actual_behavior: Evaluating the failure message references undefined expect_arch and raises NameError instead. Matching architectures do not evaluate this message. Ordinary Config.from_directory selects the matching configuration class first, so a stable supported config does not trigger this branch through that factory.

verification.description: Inspected the changed assertion, all eight configuration constructor chains and the factory's config_class invocation. Whole-parent literal searches located configuration definitions and factory callers across examples, conversion, evaluation and tests; these broader entry points are not evidence that every workflow triggers a mismatch.
verification.limits: External and dynamically constructed callers were not established.

verification.description: Executed the changed assertion with a minimal stand-in object: the matching Llama identifier passed, while a Qwen2 identifier raised NameError for expect_arch.
verification.limits: This reproduces the assertion expression only; it does not import the package or execute the full Config constructor.
